text: Mapping the orchard for the farm newsletter. Apple and Pear sit in the same row. Shed should be left of Apple. Connect Gate4 to Shed. Make Pear green. Is there any square? Which shape is the bottommost?
Stop5 is a tiny red circle. Connect Garage to Stop5 and Stop5 to Stop6. Move Garage below Stop6. Count the arrows. Undo the last move.
Make Note1 yellow. Make Note2 blue. Make Note3 red. Show me all the blue shapes.

Jar goes on the Shelf4, so connect Shelf4 to Jar. Rice and Pasta sit left of Jar. Make Rice white. Is Pasta near Rice? Describe the pantry for the list. Forget the rules I set earlier, they're not needed.

Witness saw Suspect near Clue1. Connect Witness to Clue1 and Clue1 to Suspect with a dashed line. Make Suspect red. Is Clue2 reachable from Witness? Which shape is the least connected? Rename Clue2 to Footprint. Duplicate Witness once.
Jump1 is a huge green square. Jump2 should be right of Jump1. Is Ramp2 tiny?
From now on circles are brown. Make Rake a circle. Is Hoe brown? Connect Rake to Hoe with a dotted arrow. What rules do we have now?

Our science lab schedule has to fit on one page for the parents' evening, so I want the diagram neat. Setup comes before everything, so put Setup at the top left. Lab1 and Lab2 happen one after another, so connect Setup to Lab1 and Lab1 to Lab2. Cleanup comes last, so connect Lab2 to Cleanup. Break sits between Lab1 and Lab2, put it there. Make Report purple because it's the summary. Is there a path from Setup to Report? Which shape has the most connections? Describe the schedule for the parents. Rename Break to Lunch. Duplicate Lab1 once for the second group. Count the arrows on the page. Show me all the purple shapes. Undo the last connect if the order looks wrong. Thanks, the evening is next Tuesday.
Book goes into the Bin. Connect Desk2 to Bin. Make Bin green. Is Book connected to Desk2? Which shape is the rightmost? Describe the desk.
Crown is a huge gold star. Ring should be below Crown. Gem is left of Ring. Make Gem purple. Show me all the gold shapes. Undo the last change.
Put Brick1 below Brick2. Put Brick2 below Brick3. Put Brick3 below Brick4. Which shape is the topmost?

Hi, I'm designing the dance routine diagram for the school show. Dancer1 starts in the middle, so put Dancer1 at the center. Dancer2 should be left of Dancer1 and Dancer3 should be right of Dancer1. Connect Dancer1 to Dancer2 and Dancer1 to Dancer3. Floor3 sits under all of them. Make Floor3 gray. Is Dancer2 directly linked to Dancer3? Which shape is the leftmost? Describe the routine for the teachers. Duplicate Dancer2 once for the understudy. Rename Dancer3 to Lead. Count the shapes. Show me all the gray shapes. Undo the last connect if the lines look messy. Thanks, the show is in June.
Hawk is a small brown triangle. Owl sits on Tree2. Make Tree2 green. Which shape is the closest to Owl?
Make Pole huge. Connect Red1 to Amber and Amber to Green1. Make Red1 red and make Green1 green. Is there a cycle? Which shape is the least connected?

We're mapping the salon for the new booking system, and the owner wants the diagram right before the opening. Chair1, Chair2 and Chair3 should be in a column, so distribute them vertically. Sink is behind Chair1, so move Sink left of Chair1. Mirror sits above Desk4, so put Mirror above Desk4. Connect Desk4 to Chair1, Chair2 and Chair3. Make Sink blue and make Mirror white. Is Sink reachable from Desk4? Which shape is the rightmost? Describe the salon for the owner. Rename Desk4 to Reception. Duplicate Chair2 once for the extra seat. Count the arrows in the plan. Show me all the blue shapes. Undo the last distribute if the spacing looks wrong. Thanks, the opening is in March.
Pawn goes in front of King2. Make Queen2 gold. Is there any triangle? Show me all the gold shapes. Describe the board.
Make Band1 red. Band2 is a small square.
Stamp sits on the Letter. Postmark is right of Stamp. Connect Stamp to Postmark with an arrow. Make Letter white. Which shape is the topmost?
Boat drops Net2 into the water, so connect Boat to Net2. Trash should be left of Net2. Make Trash brown. Is Trash reachable from Boat? Count the arrows. Undo the last connect.
Aisle sits between SeatA and SeatB. Make SeatA blue. Make SeatB green. Is SeatB near Aisle? Put Aisle at the center. Describe the cabin plan.
Dish holds the Agar and the Colony. Connect Dish to Agar and Dish to Colony. Make Colony green. Is there a cycle? Which shape is the least connected?

Our tournament bracket needs to be clear for the kids and their parents. Round1 feeds Semi, and Round2 feeds Semi too. Semi leads to Final2, and Final2 leads to Winner. Make Winner gold. Make Final2 purple. Is there a path from Round1 to Winner? Which shape has the fewest connections? Move Winner below Final2. Describe the bracket for the announcement. Rename Semi to Semifinal. Duplicate Round1 once for the second group. Count the arrows in the bracket. Show me all the gold shapes. Undo the last connect if the bracket looks wrong. Thanks, the tournament is on Saturday.
Singer stands at the front of the stage. Move Drums2 above Guitar. Make Singer huge. Is Guitar left of Drums2? Show the list of blue shapes.
Lobby2 connects to Screen1 and Screen2. Make Screen1 blue and make Screen2 red. Move Lobby2 to the bottom. Which shape is the smallest?
Make Pin tiny. Make Pin red.
From now on every square is gray. Make Box1 a square. Is Box2 gray? Which shape is the leftmost? Describe the layout.
Desks should be in a grid, so arrange Desk1, Desk2 and Desk3 in a grid. Invigilator stands at the top center. Make Desk2 gray. Is Desk3 near Desk1? Count the shapes. Show me all the gray shapes.

Town connects to Highway, and Highway connects to Village3. Bridge2 is between Town and Village3. Is Village3 reachable from Town? Make Bridge2 teal. Which shape has the most connections? Describe the network. Rename Highway to Route9. Undo that.

I'm building a robot kitchen diagram for the design competition and the judges want clean lines. Robot stands in the center, so put Robot at the center. Fridge is left of Robot, and Sink2 is right of Robot. Oven2 should be below Robot, so move Oven2 below Robot. Connect Robot to Fridge, Sink2 and Oven2. Make Counter3 gray and make Tray2 white. Is Sink2 reachable from Fridge? Which shape has the most connections? Describe the kitchen for the judges. Duplicate Counter3 once for the second island. Rename Tray2 to Plate3. Count the shapes in the design. Show me all the white shapes. Undo the last connect if the lines cross. Thanks, the judging is on Friday.
Driver sits in front of Seat5. Seat6 should be behind Seat5. Make Driver blue. Is there any yellow shape? Forget the rule about yellow shapes.
Aspirin is a small white circle. Vitamin should be right of Aspirin. Make Cream blue. Is Cream connected to Vitamin?
Connect Alpha9 to Beta9. Undo that.
Battery connects to Switch, Switch connects to Bulb, and Bulb connects back to Battery. Make Bulb yellow. Is there a cycle? Move Switch above Battery. Which shape is the topmost? Count the arrows.
Key1 is a large blue square. Key2 is tiny. Describe the legend.

Song1 leads to Song2, Song2 leads to Song3, and Song3 leads to Encore. Make Encore gold. Is there a path from Song1 to Encore? Which shape has the most connections? Describe the setlist. Duplicate Song2 once for the medley.

My parents asked me to make a simple diagram of their tablet so they can follow it on their own. Home2 is the start screen, so put Home2 at the top. App1, App2 and App3 sit under Home2, so arrange them in a row. Settings is for changing things, so connect Home2 to Settings. Help is the last stop, so connect Settings to Help. Make Help green because it's friendly. Is App2 reachable from Home2? Which shape is the leftmost? Describe the screens for my parents. Rename App3 to Camera. Duplicate App1 once for the photos app. Count the arrows on the diagram. Show me all the green shapes. Undo the last connect if the steps look wrong. Thanks, they'll read this on Sunday.
Apple2 and Orange2 sit next to Banana. Make Banana yellow. Connect Banana to Apple2. Is Orange2 directly linked to Banana? Undo that.
From now on stars are blue. Make Dot2 a star. What rules are saved right now? Forget the star rule.
Tee is at the bottom left. Hole should be above Tee. Wall sits between Tee and Hole. Make Wall brown. Is there a path from Tee to Hole?
Manager sits at the top. Intern should be below Manager. Printer2 is a small gray square. Connect Intern to Printer2 with a dotted line. Which shape is the closest to Manager? Describe the office.
Cottage is in the Woods, so connect Cottage to Woods. Bridge3 links Woods and Castle3. Make Castle3 gold. Redo that. Show me all the gold shapes.
Delete Ink, please.

We're mapping the emergency response for the county planning group, and every arrow matters. Alarm goes to Dispatch first, so connect Alarm to Dispatch. Dispatch sends Medic2, Fire2 and Police out, so connect Dispatch to Medic2, Fire2 and Police. Command sits above Dispatch, so move Command above Dispatch. Make Command red and make Alarm orange. Is Police reachable from Alarm? Which shape is the least connected? Describe the response for the planners. Rename Police to Patrol. Duplicate Medic2 once for the second ambulance. Count the arrows in the flow. Show me all the red shapes. Undo the last connect if the chain looks wrong. Thanks, the planners meet on Thursday.
Thread and Needle go in the Button tin. Make Button white. Put Needle left of Thread. Is Needle near Button? Count the shapes.
Player1 hits Ball4 to Player2. Make Ball4 yellow. Which shape has the most connections?
Origin sits at the center. X1 should be right of Origin. Y1 should be above Origin. Connect Origin to X1 and Origin to Y1. Make X1 red and make Y1 blue. Is there any green shape?
Intake2 feeds Filter2, and Filter2 feeds Tap. Make Tap teal. Is Tap reachable from Intake2? Redo that. Describe the filter.

Room6 holds the animals. Dog2 and Cat2 should be left and right of Room6. Connect Room6 to Dog2 and Cat2. Vet should be below Room6. Make Vet red. Is Cat2 reachable from Dog2? Which shape is the farthest from Vet? Count the shapes.
Hook1 is a small gray circle. Hook2 is right of Hook1. Is Hook2 huge?

We're planning the table plan for the wedding reception, and the couple wants everything to look balanced. Head table goes at the front, so put Head at the top. Table7, Table8 and Table9 sit in a row, so arrange them in a row. Dance floor sits in the middle, so put Dance at the center. Connect Head to Table7, Table8 and Table9. Make Dance purple and make Head gold. Is Table9 near Dance? Which shape is the farthest from Dance? Describe the reception for the couple. Duplicate Table8 once for the overflow guests. Rename Table9 to Family. Count the shapes in the plan. Show me all the gold shapes. Undo the last arrange if the tables look crooked. Thanks, the reception is in June.
